title: Neon Pink Hoverboard Pose
description: A woman with short dark hair in a bright pink ruffled crop top and pink shorts kneels on a pink and white geometric rug, gripping a purple and black hoverboard. She is positioned in a retro 80s-style living room with large windows revealing a cyberpunk cityscape under a vivid red sky.
